number_format: Inputs are binary64 ('binary64' shortest round trip, 'hex', 'exact' rational). Derived reals are decimal strings with 40 significant digits and the nearest binary64. rel_dev and cross-check residuals are short diagnostics. SI units.

definitions.continuum: Rayleigh continuum (rotary inertia, contents none), the product's continuum limit; case C with its first six merged modes periodic (truncation case: Y1 and Z1 periodic, f_r = 1.25 Hz)
definitions.consistent: the generator's planar FE at that member count with the consistent mass the product states
definitions.lumped: NOT the product's formulation: half of each member's mass at each end translation
definitions.null: not available at that member count (mid-span is not a node at N = 1; the lumped N = 1 model has no finite Z-plane mode, its only Z-plane DOF being a massless rotation), or not this package's (case D at N = 8: the sibling discrete package's values)
definitions.rules: SRSS; ABSSUM (the absolute sum); TEN_PERCENT (the ten percent method); CQC at damping 0.05 (case D): modal rules of DEL-04-10 CLM-001
